none: PAS KENT-0EEC03: Roman. Coin. Nummus AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse: Victory standing left on prow with sceptre and shield, symbol of the new Constantinople - new Rome. Inscription: None. Reece period 17. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in fine condition but worn and corroded with lower quarter of the obverse broken away. It has irregular edges, attractive green/pale brown patina but some surface corrosion present. This coin is likely to date to 330-340AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 62 no. 601 and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece & Simon…
